name: Hermes Agent v0.21 Always-On (Telegram, Discord, Slack)
description: Self-improving AI agent running 24/7 with web chat UI, memory and browser

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: REQUIRED. OpenRouter API key (openrouter.ai/keys): one key for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Hermes and hundreds of other models.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Set at least one of Telegram, Discord or Slack (or connect one later on the dashboard's Channels page).

TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to talk to the agent. Empty = deny by default; approve people via DM pairing on the dashboard.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord bot token (Developer Portal > Bot). Enable the Message Content intent for the bot.

DISCORD_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to talk to the agent. Empty = deny by default plus DM pairing.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Slack also needs SLACK_APP_TOKEN (Socket Mode).

SLACK_APP_TOKEN.description: Slack app-level token (xapp-...) with connections:write, used for Socket Mode.

SLACK_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Slack member IDs allowed to talk to the agent. Empty = deny by default plus DM pairing.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional direct Anthropic key, if you prefer it over OpenRouter.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional direct OpenAI key (also used for voice tools when set).

HERMES_INFERENCE_MODEL.description: Optional process-wide model override (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6). Leave empty to pick the model in the dashboard; when set it wins over the dashboard choice.

HERMES_DASHBOARD.description: Runs the official Hermes web dashboard next to the gateway (s6-supervised, port 9119).

HERMES_DASHBOARD_HOST.description: Dashboard bind address. A non-loopback bind always enforces the dashboard login.

HERMES_DASHBOARD_PORT.description: Dashboard port; the public domain targets it.

HERMES_DASHBOARD_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL of the dashboard (Host/Origin allow-list and OAuth callbacks). Update it when you add a custom domain.

HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Dashboard login password, generated at deploy. Read it from this variable after deploying.

HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_SECRET.description: Stable signing key for dashboard sessions so logins survive restarts and redeploys.

HERMES_DASHBOARD_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Nous Portal OAuth client id (agent:...). Upstream recommends OAuth over username/password for internet-facing dashboards.

HERMES_WEBUI.description: Runs Hermes WebUI (browser and phone chat) inside this service on HERMES_WEBUI_PORT; open it via the Hermes WebUI service URL.

HERMES_WEBUI_PASSWORD.description: WebUI login password, generated at deploy. The WebUI never starts without it. Read it from this variable after deploying.

HERMES_WEBUI_HOST.description: WebUI bind address. "::" is dual-stack so the Hermes WebUI proxy reaches it over the private network.

HERMES_WEBUI_PORT.description: WebUI port on the private network; the Hermes WebUI service proxies to it.

HERMES_WEBUI_SECURE.description: Marks WebUI session cookies Secure (Railway serves it over HTTPS only).

AGENT_BROWSER_ARGS.description: Container-safe launch flags for the bundled headless Chromium (no user-namespace sandbox, no reliance on a large /dev/shm). Setting this replaces Hermes' auto-detected flags.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Hermes gets to finish turns and checkpoint SQLite before the old container is stopped on redeploy.

PORT.description: Port Railway's healthcheck and public domain use; must match HERMES_DASHBOARD_PORT.

HERMES_WEBUI_UPSTREAM.description: Private-network address of the WebUI, which runs inside the Hermes service (it needs Hermes' volume).

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; Railway's healthcheck and public domain use it.
